notes.title: Update note March 27
notes.content:
Hello gamers. welcome.

Thanks for your interest in our game.
There are still many areas where we are lacking,
but we will do our best to put on a better game.
we will try to make it.


Updated items listed below.


- zombie improvements
By patterning the various movements of zombies,
Adjusted the phenomenon of following the player intensively
Zombie movement speed for each difficulty has also been adjusted.

- Added monsters
Plant-type monsters that attack from a distance have been added.

- other features
Boss entry and clear indications have been added.
Weapon upgrade costs and probabilities have been adjusted.
Other UI parts have been adjusted.

To deliver information that is helpful for game progress and development
and Please refer to the email address below for consultation.

info@funwave.co.kr

notes.title: update notes March 16
notes.content:
Hello, gamers. Welcome.

Thank you for your interest in our game.
It's already the 3rd update since Early Access.
I'm still lacking in many areas, but I'll try to play a better game.
I will try to make it.

Updated the items listed below.


- Add Hyanggyo area
A new local hyanggyo map has been added.
Additional missions and Boss Monster were also added.
All scene transitions have been modified to look natural.
Check out Gameplay for more information.

- Modify store functionality
If the scroll movement of the store has been added,
the direction of the weapon draw has also been changed.


Thank you for using our test game.

If you can proceed with the game and get information to help develop it,
Please refer to the email address below when you want to speak.

info@funwave.co.kr

notes.title: Update Notes March 9
notes.content:
Hello, gamers. Welcome.

Thank you for your interest in our game.
We're going to make our game even better.
I'm working hard.


Updated the items listed below.


- Localizing
Language packs have been added to support various languages, although they are not good enough.
Language to be added : 
Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Korean, French, German,
Italian, Spanish

- Change Sub Title
The subtitle of "Crimson hanbok" has been revised to "Face the sins"

- Balancing the game
We've adjusted some of the gun, some of the zombie's capabilities and balanced them.
If you clear the boss, a certain soul and coin will be dropped.
Proceed with additional minor error correction operations.


Thank you for using our test game.

If you can proceed with the game and get information to help develop it,
Please refer to the email address below when you want to speak.

notes.title: update notes March 2
notes.content:
Hello, gamers. Welcome.

Thank you for your interest in our game.
We're going to make our game even better.
I'm working hard.


Updated the items listed below.

- Proximity attacks have been added to enable at regular intervals.
When you can't use a gun because you don't have a bullet, or when a lot of zombies come in,
You can escape such a difficult situation.

- Implementing additional curse functionality
One of the main contents of the game, the curse function, has been implemented.
Various curses are placed on the main character, making the game more difficult.

- Balancing the game
We've adjusted some of the gun, some of the zombie's capabilities and balanced them.
